title: Product measure for uniform sample inputs
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, the measure associated with a uniform random element of $(\{−1,1\}^n)^m$ is the product, over the $m$ coordinates, of the measures associated with uniform random elements of $\{−1,1\}^n$.
